# Lemvig

Lemvig is a Danish municipality (kommune) named in the AFDK 2024 report as part of a "Sundhedsklynge Kommune" (municipal health cluster) grouping [^src1]. It is mentioned once in the corpus, within a chapter documenting Indicator 8 (Structured patient education) of the AFDK program (Atrial Fibrillation in Denmark), which is administered by the Danish Clinical Quality Program (Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram). That chapter includes a geographic overview of the Danish health clusters participating in the AFDK program, and Lemvig appears in this overview as one of the participating municipalities [^src1]. No further details, relationships, or claims about Lemvig are provided in the available data.
